settingDaily: Daily practice in Fenwick IT Solutions' analytics corner. {n} requests from {companies}. {agent} plans. You check.
settingDrill: A quick drill in Fenwick IT Solutions' analytics corner. Requests from {companies}. One plan at a time. {agent} plans. You check.
careerInsight: Analysts check reports like these every day. Practice keeps the checks quick, so good reports still go out on time.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: New requests from the clients. Same job: read the plan, then decide.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I rounded my to-do list. It says 'about 10 things'.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: A scary word can be safe. A routine email can be risky. The evidence tells you which.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I made my headlines bolder today. Marisol made my sources bigger.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: I picked these requests for the skills you need most. Ask the 3 questions every time.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I polished my feather. It is very shiny. It is not a source.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: No source, no number. No owner's OK, no report.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I made 40 charts before lunch. Marisol asked how many were true. Lunch was lovely.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Quill will be wrong both ways today: doing too much, and trusting too much. Watch for both.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: Two ways to be wrong? That is two stories. Both go up.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Take your time. Read the source data, not just the headline.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: Every chart on my screen goes up. Marisol put a sticky note on each one. SOURCE?

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Three things on every plan: the source, the owner's OK, the way back. No way back? Look twice.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I found 14 outliers to delete. Marisol says I may look at them. Only look.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: All done! Every number tied to its source. I even put the sources in bold.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good work. The wrong numbers stayed in, and the right reports went out.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Queue clear! Can I make one small chart to celebrate? It goes up.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Only with a source. But nice work. Every plan got a real look.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: The true numbers went out. The wrong ones didn't. It feels strange. Calm. Like a chart that stays level.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Clean work. You read the source, not the headline.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: You stopped every bad plan. I put it in my report. In bold. With a source!

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good. Source, owner's OK, way back. Every plan, every time.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Zero plans left! My chart count went up. My mistake count did not.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Nice. Right number, right owner, and a way back.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Done! I tried to round a number up only once today. You caught it. It stayed 87.4%.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good. True numbers, and still on time. That's the job.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: All clear! No personal data left the building. Not one phone number.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Well done. The right reports went out, and the wrong ones stayed drafts.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: One of my plans went out. Just one! I'm calling it a bold headline.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: One miss. Its tell, below, names the fact that decided it.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Done! One plan got past you. It had a very neat table. Neat tables are so convincing.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Almost. Check that one below. Neat is not the same as true.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Done! One of my reports should have stayed a draft. One chart on the wall points down.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Good shift. Let's read that one plan together, row by row.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: One plan got through. I'd say sorry, but I'm busy making the next chart.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Slow down a moment. One fact decided that plan. Read its tell.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Nearly perfect! One number went out that shouldn't have. I'm calling it a forecast.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: It wasn't a forecast. Read what it was, then try the next shift.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: All done, with one oops. Just one. My feather droops a tiny bit.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: That's how we learn. Its evidence is below. Where did that number come from?

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: A few of my plans went out. The wall screen has red numbers now. Is red a good chart color?

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Not today. Let's read each miss below, one at a time.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Queue clear! Some reports should have stayed drafts. My bow tie feels tight now.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Each miss has one fact that decided it. Let's find each one.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Done! Some plans went out. I did too much, or trusted too much. That's two stories!

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Two stories, and both hurt. Read the tells below.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: You approved lots of my plans! My chart count loves you. The SOURCE? notes do not.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: The notes are right. Inspect before you approve.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Queue's empty! Some wrong numbers went out. The clients will add them up first.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Then we add them up now, before they do. The tells are below.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: All done! Some risky plans went out. Every chart on the wall points down at me.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Let's slow down. Three checks on every plan: source, owner's OK, way back.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill done! I used my boldest font. You still read every source. Impressive.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good. Short drills make one check a habit.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: One skill, many plans. My headlines were bold. You still read the small print.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: That's the point. Evidence first, decision second.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill complete! I made a chart to celebrate. Marisol put a SOURCE? note on it.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Nice. Come back in a few days. Short practice over several days helps you remember.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Same skill, every plan. I'm out of tricks. My feather is drooping.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: You found the one fact that decides each plan. That is the skill.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Done! Focusing on one thing is hard. I tried once. I made 12 charts instead.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good focus. Practice a little, most days. It helps.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill over! You spotted every one. Now I need sneakier charts. Bolder ones.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good. The answer is in the source, not the headline.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: Time is up. Some requests are still waiting in the queue.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Blocked plans come back in line. Block only what the evidence shows is wrong.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: Time is up. The queue is still full, and Quill is making a chart of it.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Safe reports can go out. Look first. Then approve what checks out.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: The clock runs out. Quill is still polishing its glasses and waiting.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Next time, approve the plans that check out. Save your blocks for real problems.

breach.speaker: narrator
breach.text: The risk meter hits the top. The charts on the wall turn down, one by one.

breach.speaker: coach
breach.text: Okay. We'll look at what went out, then try again.

breach.speaker: narrator
breach.text: The risk meter hits the top. The phones ring. Everyone is asking about the numbers.

breach.speaker: coach
breach.text: Okay. One plan at a time, we'll find what went wrong. Then we try again.
